type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

ConfigView.description: JSON representation of public contract configuration.

attestor_id.description: Account allowed to attest PnL snapshots.

owner_id.description: Account allowed to administer the registry.

paused.description: Whether new registrations and subscriptions are paused.

PnlSnapshotView.description: JSON representation of an attested public PnL snapshot.

data_hash.description: Public hash or pointer to the off-chain attestation data.

trades_count.description: Number of trades in the reporting window.

SubscriptionView.description: JSON representation of a follower's subscription.

epoch_granted.description: Most recent key epoch granted to this follower.

revoked.description: Whether the trader revoked the subscription.

TraderView.description: JSON representation of a registered trader.

active.description: Whether the trader accepts new subscriptions.

active_followers.description: Number of followers currently counted as active.

max_followers.description: Maximum number of concurrently subscribed followers.

U128.description: JSON decimal-string wrapper for unsigned 128-bit amounts.

U64.description: JSON decimal-string wrapper for unsigned 64-bit timestamps.
